_how: Edit this file on GitHub to put a message at the top of everyone's home page (phone app, which looks about twice a day). Each alert needs an id and a text (plain, up to 200 characters); a new id shows again to people who dismissed an older one. Optional: link (an https address, opened by an Open button), until (YYYY-MM-DD, the last day it shows), minVersionCode / maxVersionCode (only for those versions). Example: {"id": "maint-11-08", "text": "Server maintenance tonight from 10pm", "until": "2026-11-08"}. Update alerts don't need this file: they come from the releases.
